title: 6x Fantasi Remix | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Fantasi Remix 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle Pack
If you’re a fan of our Fantasi Remix vape juices in 70/30 mix, then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our unique flavors in Fantasi Remix Shortfills so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favorite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Blue Raspberry & Cherry Ice –
The true-blue gem in the Fantasi Ice collection blended with succulent, juicy cherries.
Blue Raspberry X Lemonade –
Juicy raspberries with a sweet candy twist blended with zesty lemonade.
Fruit X Twist
–
Juicy oranges, ripe peaches, crisp apples, and mouthwatering passion fruits with a sparkling blend
Tropical X Thunder
A tropical fusion of sweet and tangy fruit medley.
BlackCurrant X Grape Apple –
Ripe, juicy blackberries intertwine with the distinctive flavors of succulent grapes and fresh, crisp apples.
Grape X Strawberry
–
Authentic flavours of fresh fruit, and with a hint of sparkle.
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporised correctly. All of our Fantasi Vape Liquids come in a range of sizes and strengths. You can get your 0mg Fantasi 70/30 vape juice in 120ml Shortfill Bottles. If you want nicotine with your Shortfills, we stock 100ml and 120ml bottles at either 3mg or 6mg nicotine strength.
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Blue Raspberry X Cherry Ice Shortfill
1x Blue Raspberry X Lemonade Shortfill
1x Fruit X Twist Shortfill
1x Tropical X Thunder Shortfill
1x Blackcurrant X Grape Apple Shortfill
1x Grape X Strawberry Shortfill
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
10ml, 100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavor
Apple, Berry, Berry Lemonade, Blackberry, Blackcurrant, Blue Razz, Blue Razz Cherry, Blue Razz Lemonade, Blueberry, Cherry, Drinks, Fruit, Ice Cool, Lemon, Lemonade, Mango, Melon, Raspberry, Tropical
Highlights:
6x unique flavour combo Fantasi Remix e-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
6 popular e-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
